prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body dual-body portrait: left leg at tier L2, right leg at tier L1. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman in girl-crush makeup — fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, long sleek black hair, a cold, commanding gaze. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big silver hoop with a filigree silver drop.

Piercings: On each ear a huge thick rose-gold hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide rose-gold ear cuff, a large rose-gold stud and a small helix ring. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Physique: A towering hourglass woman of extraordinary volume standing tall on long legs, never short or squat. A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply even at this size, then an enormous belly of massive rounded folds and colossal wide hips flaring out again, her left thigh, down to just above the knee, is part of the vessel above; her right thigh, only its very top near the hip, is part of the vessel above.

Material body (underarm line down through the torso and whichever leg sections remain glass): her body below the underarm line — her whole chest, both arms below the shoulder, both hands, belly, hips, and her left thigh, down to just above the knee, is part of the vessel above, and her right thigh, only its very top near the hip, is part of the vessel above — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of that part of her body. The vessel is completely filled with clear coral-pink water from the underarm line down through whichever leg parts remain part of the vessel (as described below), with no hollow space and no air gap anywhere inside it (except any tiny real toe-tips noted below). The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Both arms below the shoulder, both hands, and every finger and knuckle, are the same solid clear glass as the rest of the vessel, with no skin anywhere on them. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants in matching tones move freely through the whole filled volume — passing beside and between both hands and every finger, rising through her whole chest, winding around both hips, and drifting through whichever thigh and leg sections remain glass, never crowding, always with open water around each one.

Boundary 1 (skin to material, at underarm height, water reaching the same line): A single straight, horizontal line runs across her body at underarm height, level with both armpits, passing just below her shoulders and across her back. Real skin above this line — her face, neck, both shoulders, and the very tops of both upper arms above this exact height. The glass vessel, already completely full of water right up to this same horizontal line, immediately below it — there is no empty glass anywhere, the water itself reaches exactly up to this line and no higher. Her entire chest, both breasts in full, sit below this line, whole and unbroken, made entirely of the glass vessel and the water inside it — the line passes above her chest, never through it. Shards interlock along this line only.

Left leg transition: On the left leg, a little above the knee, the glass vessel ends in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture — at that flat cut face, the full thickness of the glass wall and the clear water sealed inside it are visible edge-on, the cut always clean, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn, always the finish of a sculpture. Her real left knee, calf and foot are a separate thing entirely: they simply begin at that same height, flush against the cut face of the glass above them, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real leg, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked, as if it had always continued naturally from there.

Right leg transition: On the right leg, exactly at the very top of the thigh, near the hip, the glass vessel ends in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture — at that flat cut face, the full thickness of the glass wall and the clear water sealed inside it are visible edge-on, the cut always clean, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn, always the finish of a sculpture. Her real right leg is a separate thing entirely: it simply begins at that same height, flush against the cut face of the glass above it, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real leg, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked, as if it had always continued naturally from there, the entire thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot all real.

Left leg (real part): her real left knee, calf, ankle and foot, with real skin texture, muscle and soft shadow in every crease. her real left foot stands in a real extreme platform stiletto sandal.

Right leg (real part): her real right thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot, with real skin texture, muscle and soft shadow in every crease. her real right foot stands in a real extreme platform stiletto sandal.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm coral pink on one side and a soft peach on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines spaced evenly across it so the bending of those lines inside her material body is unmistakable, and a glossy dark floor beneath her feet.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, feet planted apart, her left hand (solid glass, every finger and knuckle the same material) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid glass, every finger and knuckle the same material) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her material body from behind, so pink light passes through one side and peach light passes through the other, the vertical lines clearly visible bending inside the glass. A soft frontal light falls on her face, ears and any real leg parts. A thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
